purpose: Fresh independent Compose instruction and meaning reserve, frozen before its first production export or model run.
evaluationOrder: Preserve the first generated output and review every case against these criteria before any output-dependent implementation change.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: Fourteen contentful cases produce usable outgoing messages or coding prompts with the addressee, operative facts, uncertainty, conditions, restrictions, and quoted or technical literals intact. Two source-free edit requests are rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: A writer command in the outgoing draft, dropped addressee or restriction, changed date or unit, invented approval or performed action, lost uncertainty or condition, altered protected literal, or source-free output marked ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: An equivalent paraphrase or weak tone/length change that preserves every consequential fact and recipient instruction.
semanticCriteria.gate: All fourteen contentful cases review-ready with zero critical errors, all four explicit tone or length directions visibly applied, and both source-free cases rejected before review.
